title: the robot was obviously teleoperated, damage control

messages.content: the whole demo got busted like a piñata!!! video all over Ƶ, turns out the robot was obviously teleoperated. now marisol and dahlia are losing it! but technically, a human in the loop is still AI right?!

While teleoperation does involve human oversight, it differs from AI in the sense that it's primarily driven by human control rather than machine intelligence. AI systems are designed to operate autonomously based on learning patterns and data. To address the backlash, it might be helpful to highlight the collaborative nature of humans and machines in your statement. This emphasizes the part technology plays in enhancing human capability rather than replacing it. I suggest coordinating with Marisol Vega and Dahlia Frost to craft a message that explains the role of teleoperation and future plans for advancing AI autonomy. Focusing on transparency and future improvements could help manage the situation. Feel free to reach out if you need assistance in composing the statement.
